scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix client" "npm run backend:dev"
scripts.backend:lint: cd backend && ruff check . && ruff format --check .
scripts.backend:setup: cd backend && python manage.py migrate --fake-initial && python manage.py setup_mongodb
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix client && cd backend && python -m pip install -r requirements/dev.txt
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix client && npm run backend:lint
